events.text: An oasis town on the Silk Road: date palms, camels and traders speaking nine languages at once.

effects.log: Cool water, sweet dates and a song from somewhere far west.

choices.text: Trade stories with a caravan master

effects.log: He has crossed the desert thirty times. He tells you where the water is, and the bandits.

events.text: A caravan needs a guard to cross the Taklamakan: two weeks of sand, sun, and nothing.

ok.log: Two weeks, one sandstorm, no losses. (45 taels)

fail.log: Heat sickness on the eighth day. You arrive, but the caravan master docks your pay. (10 taels)

effects.log: 'Wise,' says the caravan master. 'The desert eats the brave first.'

events.text: The snows of Kunlun glitter above the desert. They say the Kunlun sect's masters cross them without leaving footprints.

choices.text: Climb as high as you dare

effects.log: The air thins, the world shrinks below you. You understand the Kunlun a little.
Pink snow above gold sand. You will never forget it.

events.text: Cliffside caves painted with a thousand Buddhas. A monk copies the paintings by lamplight, one line a day.

effects.log: A week of lamplight and silence. Your mind has never been so still.
Guardian kings with swords in impossible stances. Impossible, until you try them.

events.text: A camel trader offers you a camel for a price he swears is ruinous to himself. The camel spits on you.

effects.log: It spits on everyone. It is also the most loyal creature you have ever owned.
The trader laughs so hard he gives you tea for free.

events.text: Crossing the desert, you see a city of white towers shimmering on the horizon. It moves when you move.

effects.log: It vanishes. You find a real well where it stood.

choices.text: Mark it on your map anyway

effects.log: You draw it very carefully. A map seller later buys the map for five taels.

events.text: In the western desert, a ruined temple with red-stained walls. Locals will not go within a li of it.

ok.log: Under the altar: an old manual, half burned. You burn the other half.

fail.log: Something in the ruins does not want you there. You leave with a fever and nightmares.

effects.log: The caravan master thanks you and gives the ruins a wide berth.

events.text: The great bazaar of the west: glass from Persia, horses from Ferghana, and a spice that makes your mouth go numb.

effects.log: Useful for wounds, and for impressing Sichuan people. (−5 taels)
Horses the colour of gold that "sweat blood". You believe it when you see them.

events.text: Masked riders come out of the dunes at noon, circling your caravan.

ok.log: Their leader falls; the rest scatter into the dunes.

fail.log: They take a camel and some of your blood.

choices.text: Offer water instead of a fight

effects.log: Water is worth more than silver here. They take a skin and let the caravan pass.

events.text: In the desert night the stars are so many that the sky looks white. A caravan master names them for you.

effects.log: You can find north in any desert now.
You dream of flying. You wake with sand in your ears.

events.text: A swordsman from the far west with a curved blade challenges anyone at the oasis. His footwork is strange and beautiful.

ok.log: A draw. You teach each other one form each.

fail.log: His curved blade finds the gap every time. You learn anyway.

effects.log: You see his rhythm. It is like a dance in three beats.

events.text: A monastery on the edge of the Kunlun snows offers shelter to anyone who will chant with the monks at dawn.

choices.text: Chant with them for a month

effects.log: Your breath deepens with every dawn.
You carry water up an icy path every morning. Your legs thank you, later.

events.text: You find a caravan buried in sand, camels and all. The merchant's ledger is still in his saddlebag.

choices.text: Return the ledger to his family

effects.log: His family weeps and gives you the last of his silver.
It takes a day. The wind covers the graves by nightfall.

events.text: A melon farmer at the oasis gives every traveller one melon, free, for luck. Nobody knows why.

effects.log: The sweetest thing you have ever eaten. You ask why. He only smiles.

choices.text: Work his field for a day to pay

effects.log: He laughs, lets you, and gives you three melons.

events.text: The Heavenly Lake lies in the mountains of the west, so blue it looks painted. The Kunlun disciples meditate on its shore.

effects.log: Nobody speaks. The lake says everything.
Colder than death. You come out laughing and blue.
